venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: Sunny with highs in the mid 80s and lows dropping near 60
venues.notes_summary: Nice start with folks from upstairs joining for Meal Deals and after-work cocktails. Lull around 6pm, then familiar faces returned. Guest flow picked up again at 9pm. Industry push at 10:30-11pm. Served to midnight. Great upselling night with Murrell's Row Martinis and Mezcal drinks.

highlights.text: Strong industry connections — bartenders from Delbar and Sozou returning regularly

venues.name: Municipal Grand
venues.notes_summary: Steady Monday. AM had training for Skylar, Stephanie (server training), and Brigid (pool attendant day 2). Team did spring cleaning across vault, dry storage, BOH, mezz closet. PM was slow until 6pm then filled up until 9pm. Bar was steady with Amelia staying until 10pm to help. Excellent teamwork.

highlights.text: Productive training day — three new staff members progressing well
